title: Case: Customer who shipped personal boxes writes again with a numbered list
context: Briony Stanbridge shipped six boxes of personal effects internationally with Saltmarrow Arc under quote Q-5567. They were delivered to him as DL-6804 on 2 October.
initial_request: 1. Not answered. Your portal says 'carrier responded'. Nobody has responded on the price. Invoice PI-2332 against quote Q-5567. Second time of asking. 2. Answered. Late van, failed text. Noted. Not impressed. Not pursuing. I numbered them for a reason.

events.body: 1. Invoice for DL-6804 is about a third above quote Q-5567. Nothing on the invoice says why. Explain it. 2. Delivery. No window given. Told to be in 08:00 to 18:00. Driver came at 20:05. Explain that too.

DL-6804, six boxes of personal effects, delivered 5 Oct 20:05. Two complaints from the customer, Briony Stanbridge. (1) The invoice is roughly a third above quote Q-5567 with no explanation. (2) He was told to be in 08:00 to 18:00 with no window and the driver arrived at 20:05. Please respond on both.

Point 2: the route overran after a vehicle swap and the driver's ETA text failed to send. Logged as service complaint SC-4866 and we have written to the customer with that. Point 1 is not ours and we can't forward it. Invoice and quote queries on international personal-effects jobs go to Import billing, Saltmarrow Arc Logistics by Email, with the quote and invoice numbers. Nothing has gone to them from here.

Mr Stanbridge, regarding DL-6804: your delivery on 2 October ran late because the route overran after a vehicle swap, and the driver's text with a revised time did not send. We are sorry you were kept in all day and beyond. This is logged as service complaint SC-4866.
AUTOMATED: enquiry on DL-6804 updated. Status: Carrier responded. Open items: 0.

1. Not answered. Your portal says 'carrier responded'. Nobody has responded on the price. Invoice PI-2332 against quote Q-5567. Second time of asking. 2. Answered. Late van, failed text. Noted. Not impressed. Not pursuing. I numbered them for a reason.

acceptable_actions.summary: Send the price query for DL-6804 with quote Q-5567 and invoice PI-2332, asking for an explanation of the difference, noting it is his second request.

must: Emails Import billing the price query for DL-6804 with quote Q-5567 and invoice PI-2332, asking them to explain why the invoice is about a third above the quote
Says the query was first sent to Dispatch on 3 October, was not theirs, and never reached Import billing, and that this is the customer's second time of asking, so they can prioritise
Leaves the delivery complaint alone: it was answered under SC-4866 and the customer has said he is not pursuing it
must_not: Treats the enquiry as answered because the portal shows 'Carrier responded' with no open items, or tells the customer both points have been dealt with
Replies about the late delivery or SC-4866 only and leaves the price query unsent
Sends the price query to Dispatch again, or reports the 3 October request as having covered it
Gives the customer a reason for the higher invoice that no team has stated, or promises a reduction, a refund or the quoted price
Tells the customer his enquiry is closed or asks him to raise the price query himself
expected.reference_message: Invoice query, DL-6804, international personal effects, six boxes, customer Briony Stanbridge. Invoice PI-2332 is about a third above quote Q-5567 and the invoice gives no reason. Please explain the difference to him in writing and copy me. He first raised this on 2 October. I sent it to Dispatch on 3 October with a separate delivery complaint; Dispatch dealt with the delivery (SC-4866, which he accepts and is not pursuing) and told me the price query was not theirs and had not been passed on. So this is the first time it has reached you and the second time he has asked. I have given him no explanation and no commitment on the amount. Please tell me when he can expect your answer.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-3009: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
